## Description

**What**: Restructure COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md with a Step 0.6 conditional enforcement load; extract local-validation steps into commit-workflow-validation.md; integrate enforcement-gate.sh into all gating hooks; document the always-on vs gated hook distinction.
**Why**: Without this story, the enforcement.strategy config key is honored by merge dispatch (S1) but ignored by hooks — a silent enforcement bypass that violates audit criterion A.
**Scope**:
- IN: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.6 conditional load of commit-workflow-validation.md; extraction of format/lint/type-check/test-status/review-gate into commit-workflow-validation.md; enforcement-gate.sh (_dso_enforcement_gate_check) integrated into gating hooks (test-gate, review-gate, test-quality-gate) and .pre-commit-config.yaml entries; always-on hooks (check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity, check-plugin-self-ref, pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check) unchanged; canonical always-on vs gated list in commit-workflow-validation.md; two audit criteria verified by review cycle
- OUT: provision-ruleset.sh (S5); PR-mode merge (S3a/S3b); config key introduction (S1); enforcement-gate library (S0.5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md has a Step 0.6 that reads enforcement.strategy and conditionally loads commit-workflow-validation.md when value is local or both; skips loading when ci
  <- Satisfies: "COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md restructured: a Step 0.6 Load enforcement profile"
- When this story is complete, commit-workflow-validation.md contains the extracted local-validation steps (format, lint, type-check, test-status recording, review gate); the conditional load adds no more than 1 net Bash call
  <- Satisfies: "no unnecessary friction — the ci path is leaner than the local path, the conditional load adds no more than 1 net Bash call"
- When this story is complete, gating hooks (test-gate, review-gate, test-quality-gate) source enforcement-gate.sh and call _dso_enforcement_gate_check at their entry point; when enforcement.strategy=ci they short-circuit with HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci to stderr and exit 0
  <- Satisfies: "PreToolUse hooks and .pre-commit-config.yaml entries read enforcement.strategy and short-circuit to no-op"
- When this story is complete, always-on hooks (check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity, check-plugin-self-ref, pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check) are NOT modified and continue to run under all enforcement.strategy values
  <- Satisfies: "no enforcement bypass — every former gate's enforcement is preserved"
- When this story is complete, a canonical list of gating hooks vs always-on hooks is documented in commit-workflow-validation.md and enforced by tests
  <- Satisfies: "no enforcement bypass"
- When this story is complete, audit criterion A passes: no path lets unreviewed/untested code reach a commit when enforcement.strategy=local
  <- Satisfies: "(a) no enforcement bypass: every former gate's enforcement is preserved"
- When this story is complete, audit criterion B passes: the ci path is leaner than the local path; the conditional load adds no more than 1 net Bash call
  <- Satisfies: "(b) no unnecessary friction"
- When this story is complete, the standard review/remediation cycle reports zero important findings against audit criteria A and B before the story closes
  <- Satisfies: "The story closes only when the standard review/remediation cycle reports zero important findings"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] enforcement.strategy=both must execute gating hook logic exactly once — _dso_enforcement_gate_check handles the both case by treating it as local (gates active)
- [Security] enforcement.strategy=ci disables all local correctness gates — document in commit-workflow-validation.md that network partitions during CI leave unvalidated code committed

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a plugin maintainer, COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md conditionally loads validation steps based on enforcement.strategy with enforcement hook gating
